components.rationale: The SUPPORT states live alternatives or explicitly says the current evidence does not distinguish them. Resolving the named alternatives at the stated evidence scope preserves the contrast without inventing an outcome. The state and limit formulations repeat the same contrast, operation and two preferences. Their union supplies evidence for one unit, not two. Reviewed closed bundle: P001 SUPPORT, P005 SUPPORT.

The SUPPORT explicitly selects this next operation. Cited context preserves the alternatives and applicable scope. No action is inferred merely from a possible diagnostic outcome. The state and limit formulations repeat the same contrast, operation and two preferences. Their union supplies evidence for one unit, not two. Reviewed closed bundle: P002 SUPPORT, P006 SUPPORT, P001 CONTEXT, P005 CONTEXT.

The SUPPORT bundle states both outcome-to-alternative preferences, including their conditions. Cited context supplies the selected operation and live alternatives where these occupy separate spans. Preference is retained as preference, without an assertion of certainty. The state and limit formulations repeat the same contrast, operation and two preferences. Their union supplies evidence for one unit, not two. Reviewed closed bundle: P003 SUPPORT, P004 SUPPORT, P007 SUPPORT, P008 SUPPORT, P001 CONTEXT, P005 CONTEXT, P002 CONTEXT, P006 CONTEXT.
